== Hero Usage ==
* Heroes use this skill as a basic damage skill. They do not take into account whether or not a target is hexed or enchanted.

== Trivia ==
* A skill named Unnatural Signet was available during some of the earlier Guild Wars beta events in 2004. See [[Unnatural Signet (alpha version)]] for an in-game description.
* The functionality of this skill has changed since its introduction; see its [[/Skill history|skill history]] for details.
